name: triage-heldout-v2
frozen: 2026-10-07, written by the developer before the equipment-term list existed; never edited after (M06 Q30/Q38)
limits: Same author as the code and the term list. Replace with sets written by ฝอจ. staff before pilot.

expected_schema.scope: Facts the engine uses (rules + AI, Q29/Q40), not the AI alone
expected_schema.hazard: true when the text reports danger happening now or about to happen
expected_schema.severe_impact: true / false (impact stated and minor) / null (impact not stated)
expected_schema.registry_only: true when only records need correcting and no physical work is pending (problem cases)
expected_schema.equipment: only for cases without lines: the equipment the case is about, after the agreed precedence (Q34: serial in the requester's history, item code in the text, related case, then text). Meter/transformer compared by category; other equipment by category and item, where null means the text does not say which item and it must not be guessed
expected_schema.history: lines of the requester's earlier cases (serial lookup, Q27 ข)
expected_schema.related: lines of the case the requester referenced (Q27 ก)
